name: Publish to pub.dev

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "*-v*.*.*"

jobs:
  publish_to_pubdev:
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: read
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2

      - name: Extract package name and version from tag
        id: tag_info
        run: |
          TAG_NAME="${{ github.ref_name }}"
          # Extract package name (everything before -v)
          PACKAGE_NAME=$(echo "$TAG_NAME" | sed 's/-v[0-9].*$//')
          # Extract version (everything after -v)
          VERSION=$(echo "$TAG_NAME" | sed 's/^.*-v//')

          # Map package names to directories
          case "$PACKAGE_NAME" in
            "liquid-flutter-test-utils")
              PACKAGE_DIR="packages/liquid_flutter_test_utils"
              ;;
            "liquid-flutter-window-utils")
              PACKAGE_DIR="packages/liquid_flutter_window_utils"
              ;;
            "liquid-flutter-emd-theme")
              PACKAGE_DIR="packages/liquid_flutter_emd_theme"
              ;;
            *)
              echo "Unknown package: $PACKAGE_NAME"
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac

          echo "package_name=$PACKAGE_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "package_dir=$PACKAGE_DIR" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Package: $PACKAGE_NAME"
          echo "Version: $VERSION"
          echo "Directory: $PACKAGE_DIR"

      - name: Navigate to package directory
        working-directory: ${{ steps.tag_info.outputs.package_dir }}
        run: |
          echo "Working in: $(pwd)"
          cat pubspec.yaml | head -5

      - name: Install dependencies with retry
        working-directory: ${{ steps.tag_info.outputs.package_dir }}
        run: |
          MAX_RETRIES=5
          RETRY_COUNT=0

          while [ $RETRY_COUNT -lt $MAX_RETRIES ]; do
            echo "Attempt $((RETRY_COUNT + 1)) of $MAX_RETRIES: Running flutter pub get..."
            if flutter pub get; then
              echo "Successfully installed dependencies"
              exit 0
            else
              RETRY_COUNT=$((RETRY_COUNT + 1))
              if [ $RETRY_COUNT -lt $MAX_RETRIES ]; then
                echo "Failed to install dependencies. Waiting 2 minutes before retry..."
                sleep 120
              else
                echo "Failed to install dependencies after $MAX_RETRIES attempts"
                exit 1
              fi
            fi
          done

      - name: Publish to pub.dev
        working-directory: ${{ steps.tag_info.outputs.package_dir }}
        run: flutter pub publish --force
